steps.content: [WhiteSands, Sandstorm Background]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: One, two, three... Hey, I'm talking to you! Don't even think about running!
The brawl ends, and the defeated are tied up and neatly laid on the sand.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: ...Ha... hahaha...
A disheveled Scotch laughs with his head hanging low.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What, you hit your head and lost your mind?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait... could it be...
In the horizon, a thick blackness is rapidly expanding. The massive shadow of Apostles looms over the sand. It's the Tide of Ashes!!!
They must escape, but with what ship? The security team's big ship is nearly crippled from the recent battle, while the small sand ship can hardly carry anyone.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Crap! We got too caught up in the fight! We should've saved the ship for backup!

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Haha! The Apostles of Ashes are arriving... The ships are destroyed, and your piteous amount of Hypercubes won't help much. None of you can escape...

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Unless Tuco can sprout legs, you're gonna die with us in WhiteSands!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh? Is that so?
A voice responds slowly.
Korryn casually hands over Wright's portrait, which she was using as a weapon, to Hella, and asks her to take good care of it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Korryn?
Korryn steps onto a boulder, the wind tousling her long hair. Hella can't see Korryn's face clearly, but she hears her make a strange whistling sound.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Little Hella, let me teach you one last trick for surviving outside the city.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: To face the enemy with a brave heart is precious, but cunning adults always leave themselves a way out...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Bounty hunter tip: not only do you run, but you also take the "bounty" with you. If you don't strip them down to their underwear, how can you say you're from Tuco?
As the whistle dies down, a massive roar echoes!
On the other side of the storm, a giant shadow slowly approaches... it seems to be in the shape of a ship.
Unlike the harsh sound of sand scraping in the storm, this noise is deeper, more rhythmic, and approaches quickly with a rumbling buzz.
The intense sandstorm obscures the view, but Hella can still vaguely see something is getting closer from the other side of the storm. Is it... a giant ship or the mirage of a town?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Ha... lunatics, you're all lunatics...

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: How is this possible?! Who could possibly transform an entire town into...?!
The next second, darkness descends completely, and the sandstorm engulfs everyone...
[CG Sand Ship Launch]
When the light shines again, Hella is still dizzy from being forcibly hauled onto the ship.
She looks in shock at the sand ship beneath her feet... The familiar shabby buildings, the familiar welcome sign, and the familiar little mice covered in dust.
Beneath the "magnificent, unparalleled Tuco Palace" was a massive sand ship, as large as the entire town of Tuco!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So this is the real <color=#fb9259>Tuco</color>...?
No wonder no one can find Tuco's location. Every time they're exposed, they cunningly move the entire town!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Desert dwellers can't have too many footholds, but nothing beats a hideout that can run away with you. See, isn't this way cooler than their ship?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: This time, it's a real WhiteSands adventure. Keep a lid on your screams...
Korryn raises her hand in command and points towards the light.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Floor it! Full speed ahead!
